  function fitAdvHeader(){
    var boxes=document.querySelectorAll('.adv-header');
    for(var i=0;i<boxes.length;i++){
      var box=boxes[i];
      var fit=box.querySelector('.adv-header__fit');
      if(!fit){continue;}
      var ad=fit.querySelector('iframe,img');
      if(!ad){box.style.height='';continue;}
      var w=parseInt(ad.getAttribute('width'),10)||ad.offsetWidth;
      var h=parseInt(ad.getAttribute('height'),10)||ad.offsetHeight;
      if(!w||!h){continue;}
      var k=Math.min(1,box.clientWidth/w);
      fit.style.width=w+'px';
      fit.style.height=h+'px';
      fit.style.transform='scale('+k+')';
      fit.style.marginLeft=Math.max(0,Math.round((box.clientWidth-w*k)/2))+'px';
      box.style.height=Math.round(h*k)+'px';
    }
  }
  fitAdvHeader();
  window.addEventListener('load',fitAdvHeader);
  window.addEventListener('resize',fitAdvHeader);
})();
